prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished high-resolution STATIC desktop application screen concept, landscape 16:10, for CanonForge story production studio. This is a Figma-like straight-on screen design, not a perspective computer mockup, not a landing page. Show convincing beautifully sculpted stylized 3D Indian adult characters, expressive faces, realistic cloth materials, soft studio lighting, full bodies. Jignesh is 19, lean, brown skin, short black hair, wears a muted cricket jersey, holds a wooden cricket bat. Other characters: Rafiq organiser in casual shirt, Bhavlo umpire with hat, Pankaj landowner in kurta. Concise readable UI. The show is 'The Century Hitters'. Labels 'Cast', 'Jignesh', 'Knows 4', 'Blind to 18', and one primary action 'Develop spin-off'. User can select a character then start a canon-safe spin-off. Keep numbers confined to selected character detail. Add one short premise 'Paid to lose at the only thing he does well.' No graphs, no long explanatory text, no dashboard statistics. Compact human-designed typography and spacing. Essential controls and names should be clear. Add an external narrow design-board caption area with option name and five palette swatches with hex labels, outside application chrome. These are concept illustrations, no requirement to code. OPTION A 'Sage Atelier'. Palette #F7F8F3 paper, #E7EDDF sage, #315A46 forest, #C8B59B sand, #29392F ink. Application layout: persistent slim left sidebar with CanonForge wordmark, Discover, Shows, recent projects. Breadcrumb top bar. Show-level tabs Overview, Episodes, Cast selected, Spin-offs. Central 2-by-2 collection of roomy 3D character portrait display cards on subtle sage surfaces, Jignesh selected in neutral outline. Right 28% inspector with Jignesh closeup small, name, role, short premise, knows/blind labeled split, forest green CTA. Quiet warm editorial studio aesthetic, premium product UI. Photorealistic toy-like sculpted 3D figures, not crude geometric placeholders.
